definitions: A metal pin or bar used for fastening a door or window.
A threaded metal pin used with a nut to fasten objects together.
A sudden dash or run for safety.
A large roll of fabric or wallpaper.
examples: He slid the bolt into place.
Tighten the nut on the bolt.
A bolt of lightning struck the tree.
The horse made a bolt for the gate.
She bought a whole bolt of silk.
